description: Comparative benchmark pricing across key Indian informal scrap hubs vs. KAWA formal CPCB recycler handover rates under E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.

benchmarks.economicDriver: Formal hydrometallurgical processing extracts Gold (Au), Silver (Ag), Palladium (Pd), Gallium (Ga) at >98% yield and earns EPR certificates, enabling recyclers to pay 36.8% higher to grassroots collectors.
Authorized battery dismantlers recover strategic Lithium (Li) and Cobalt (Co) black mass which is completely burned/lost in backyard smash-and-burn operations.
Informal yards only pay for the heavy copper deflection yoke and dump leaded glass into open sewers. CPCB facilities recycle the funnel glass and extract Indium (In).
Open-air wire burning oxidizes and incinerates 25-35% of the copper wire mass. Mechanical cryogenic stripping preserves 99.2% copper mass and recovers commercial PVC granules.
Refrigerant vacuum capture and rare-earth Neodymium (Nd) permanent magnet recovery creates high-value industrial reuse streams.
Direct induction furnace supply chain avoids 2 intermediate middlemen traders.
Clean segregation by polymer type under quality grading produces food/industrial grade regrind flakes with EPR plastic packaging credits.
